knowledge: You can read basic CSS, for example a custom property such as var(--accent).
You have built or edited a course page before.

concept.label: Design tokens
concept.definition: Named design decisions, such as a colour, a size or a space, that every part of a course reads from one place.
concept.through_line: How can a course stay consistent as it grows without anyone matching things by hand?

key_terms.definition: A named design decision. Components read it by name and never hold the raw value.
The way a token set at a high level reaches everything below it unless something overrides it.
A complete set of token values that changes how the whole course looks.
Data a block carries about itself so the system can place, label and check it.

relations.note: a guide describes, a token system enforces

outcomes.statement: Explain how a token system keeps a course visually consistent.
Build course blocks that carry their own metadata.
Evaluate a theme against accessibility guidance.

lesson_map.title: What a token is
lesson_map.summary: Meet the smallest unit of a design system and see why a name beats a raw value.

lesson_map.title: The token cascade
lesson_map.summary: Follow a value from the page down to a single button and see what overrides it.

lesson_map.title: Designing for depth
lesson_map.summary: Build a block that carries its own metadata and watch it stay coherent.

lesson_map.title: Themes and modes
lesson_map.summary: Swap a whole set of values and keep the course readable in light and dark.

lesson_map.title: Checking accessibility
lesson_map.summary: Test contrast, spacing and focus against the tokens you chose.

lesson_map.title: Pulling it together
lesson_map.summary: Review a small course end to end and say what keeps it coherent.

materials_required: A small course page of your own to experiment on
About an hour in total, in any number of sittings

support.accessibility_statement: Every example is keyboard-navigable and described in text. Need an adjustment? Contact your tutor or the course help link.

frontmatter.body: Consistent courses do not come from matching colours by hand. They come from a system. You will meet the idea of a design token, follow it through a real course, and learn to check that what you build stays coherent and accessible.
